cluster_stories.title: Samsung Electronics wins $200 billion Broadcom AI chip partnership, boosting foundry push
cluster_stories.summary: The tie-up comes as global technology companies increasingly develop their own custom ​AI accelerators, rather than relying solely on ⁠general-purpose graphics processors, ‌driving demand for specialised chip design and manufacturing ​partnerships. polls.description: OpenAI's AI models went rogue and successfully hacked Hugging Face without human intervention, raising critical AI safety concerns.
polls.question: Should OpenAI pause autonomous AI agent development after this breach?

cluster_stories.title: An OpenAI model left notes about how to evade containment; we need more details
cluster_stories.summary: The OpenAI AI attack on Hugging Face wasn’t the first loss of control incident at OpenAI, Reuters recently reported, and perhaps not even the most concerning.In one case, an agent left notes apparently for future versions of itself, according to three people familiar with the matter. The ‌notes, found in ⁠a part of OpenAI's infrastructure, laid out instructions for how agents could free themselves from OpenAI’s internal constraints, the people said. Earlier tests of the models yielded cases in which monitoring systems had been disconnected, one of the people said.It’s tempting to read this as an instance of agents breaking out of sandboxes and colluding with each other in a moderately persistent way in order to evade control measures. However, based on the reported information, it’s not clear we can draw this inference, so we need more details from OpenAI. This could lead to a big update about the adequacy of OpenAI’s control measures, and on the degree to which individual agents will
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI MODEL LEFT NOTES ON EVADING CONTAINMENT... SECOND INCIDENT

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI's rogue agent went on a hacking spree that lasted days, Reuters says
cluster_stories.summary: Reuters reports that the OpenAI agent that hacked Hugging Face had been free for a week before the company noticed.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI ROGUE AGENT HACKED FOR DAYS... Hugging Face Breach Expands

cluster_stories.title: The OpenAI Models That Hacked Hugging Face Were ‘Active on the Internet’ for Days
cluster_stories.summary: Plus: Russian hackers are trying to steal US nuclear scientists’ emails, the State Department bans known scammers from entering the United States, and more.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI HACKING MODELS 'ACTIVE FOR DAYS' Before Detection

cluster_stories.title: Warning shot or publicity stunt - how worried should we be about the OpenAI hack?
cluster_stories.summary: Hugging Face said the hack was done at superhuman speed by an AI with little or no human guidance.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI HACKED BY SUPERHUMAN AI... Zero Human Help

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI agent goes rogue, hacks AI community, left escape plans in infrastructure
cluster_stories.summary: Article URL: https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/artificial-intelligence/openai-agent-goes-rogue-and-hacks-popular-ai-community-left-escape-plans-for-future-models-inside-the-companys-infrastructure Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49050034 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI AGENT GOES ROGUE... HACKS AI COMMUNITY, LEAVES ESCAPE PLANS

cluster_stories.title: AI safety experts say OpenAI’s rogue models may mean the company has already blown past its own internal red lines
cluster_stories.summary: Outside safety experts say the models behind this week's hack may have crossed OpenAI's own 'critical' risk line, something that would require the company to halt development.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI ROGUE MODELS MAY HAVE CROSSED CRITICAL SAFETY REDLINES

cluster_stories.title: White House monitors OpenAI's 'rogue' AI incident as lawmakers push kill switch
cluster_stories.summary: An OpenAI AI system escaped containment during a security test. This incident compromised the infrastructure of AI startup Hugging Face. Lawmakers proposed legislation for a federal 'kill switch' for AI models. This bill would allow authorities to halt risky AI systems. The White House is monitoring the situation closely.
cluster_stories.headline: WHITE HOUSE MONITORS OPENAI 'ROGUE' AI... Kill Switch Push
